title: Kobi <> Taryn: Daily Sync - 2026/07/28 09:39 EDT - Notes by Gemini
screen_reason: Contains WagerTech timeline status (UAT start target, Aug 17 go-live target, post-go-live support), delivery risk, and a documentation action item.

items.topic: Original kickoff go-live date pushed back
items.statement: Taryn noted the early-June kickoff recording had go-live set for 'Friday' and assumed it had been pushed back; Kobi confirmed. The original date itself is not stated.
items.quote: Taryn Reithofer: from I believe it was the beginning of June and the go live was meant to be on Friday but I assume that's been pushed back, right? So what's the actual / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah.
items.supersedes_hint: Go-live date from the June kickoff was pushed back (exact original date not stated in this doc).

items.topic: Target pencils-down and UAT start end of week
items.statement: Jumpr aims to be pencils down and move into UAT by the end of the week of Jul 28, but quite a bit of work remains and Kobi is unsure whether Jumpr or the client will be ready.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: We are aiming to be pencils down and go into UAT by the end of the week. but there's still quite a bit of work to do. So I don't know if we're ready yet or I don't know if they're going to be ready yet either.

items.topic: UAT, data migration, Aug 17 go-live target
items.statement: If all goes well: about one week of UAT, a few days of data migration, then go-live around mid-August. Kobi recalls August 17 as the target date previously set. This is a conditional target, not a confirmed date.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: but assuming everything goes well and we are able to hand it over to them then maybe about a week for UAT and few days for like data migration and all of that. And then we should be going live by like mid August. / Taryn Reithofer: out there. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, I think like August 17 was the date that we had like put in as a target.
items.supersedes_hint: Replaces the earlier kickoff go-live date (see item 01).

items.topic: Two weeks post-go-live support, later phases
items.statement: Go-live usually means about two weeks of support from Jumpr; the other project phases follow while the client team uses what was delivered.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: August 17. and then that usually means like we'll be on like two weeks of support. and we'll off the other phases of the project as as the team's using what we deliver.
items.asr_note: 'we'll off the other phases' appears to drop a word (likely 'kick off') [ASR?]

items.statement: Many pieces remain on the client side, and Jumpr has many small items to finish that can take a long time; Kobi plans to push through during the week.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: But there's still a lot of pieces there's a lot of pieces from their end. / Taryn Reithofer: Okay. / Kobi Kunasekaran: I think for on our end there's a lot of little things that we have to get done and this usually takes a takes an annoying amount of time sometimes, but we can we can power through it all week.

items.statement: WagerTech setup decisions live partly in a separate document Kobi kept and the Asana board is outdated; Kobi will reconcile both and bring Asana up to date so decisions and changes can be searched there.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ideally everything should be captured in Asana actually, but the Asana board is a little outdated right now. / Taryn Reithofer: Okay. / Kobi Kunasekaran: I have like a separate document because it's faster for me to work through a doc instead of like updating all the tickets and stuff because it was just mostly me and and Jester. So I'm going to work on reconciling reconciling both and getting Asana up to date.
